liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard to Handle** (2 reviews): PigPen performs well, and Jerry's riff is precisely timed in this rendition; This version is the undisputed champion of the song, featuring an explosive climax [16][22]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-29.sbd.frisco.16782.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 47 songs; 315 min; rated 4.65/5 by 54 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is excellent, making the drum solo between Alligator and the jam feel intimate; The quintet sounds earnest, gritty, and folky, resembling a jug band in unison [14][19]
- **gd1971-04-29.sbd.murphy.1858.shnf**: soundboard; 47 songs; 314 min [3]
- **gd1971-04-29.mtx.hansokolow.97660.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 229 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1971-04-29.sbd.unknown.4333.shnf**: soundboard; 46 songs; 314 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The Hard to Handle performance is considered the best ever by this listener [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-29.sbd.frisco.16782.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris Frisco; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The reviewer possessed a sixty-fourth generation tape of this specific show; Lineage is mostly soundboard to master reel to CD, refined by Chris Frisco [1][23]
- **gd1971-04-29.sbd.murphy.1858.shnf**: transferred by Bob Murphy; source: MSR 7 inch (7.5 ips) Revox A 77 >Alesis Masterlink>CD-R [3]. Also: SHN conversion and upload were performed by Bob Murphy [3]
- **gd1971-04-29.mtx.hansokolow.97660.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=33565 and AUD: shnid=26568 [4]. Also: Matrixing involved extensive time, pitch, and level adjustments due to challenging audio quality [4]
- **gd1971-04-29.sbd.unknown.4333.shnf**: transferred by Bill Gadsden; source: SBD>MR : Shure line mixers > Sony reel to reel (middle of the line model, exact model unknown) at 7 1/2 ips onto BASF 90 minute reels MR>CDR: Revox A77 reel to… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead & Procol Harum Fillmore East PROG 1971 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-procol-harum-fillmore-east-prog-1971) [26]
